data.description:
## testing_mode: GREEN

## What
Add --check-tags flag to bug-classification-audit.sh that enumerates in-use bug-type-* tags across closed tickets and validates each against the current slug registry.

## Changes to plugins/dso/scripts/bug-classification-audit.sh

### --check-tags mode behavior
1. Extract all known slugs from registry JSON (SLUG_SET)
2. Run: ${TICKET_CMD:-$SCRIPT_DIR/ticket} list --status=closed 2>/dev/null | python3 -c 'parse tags, collect bug-type-* values'
3. For each bug-type-<slug> tag found, strip the 'bug-type-' prefix to get the slug
4. If slug not in SLUG_SET: print 'AUDIT FAIL: tag=bug-type-<slug> is not a current registry slug' and exit 1
5. If all tags are valid: print 'AUDIT PASS: <N> in-use bug-type tags validated' and exit 0
6. If no bug-type-* tags found: print 'AUDIT PASS: no in-use bug-type tags found' and exit 0

### TICKET_CMD override
Respect TICKET_CMD env var for testability (same pattern as other scripts in this repo).

## Done when
Running bash tests/scripts/test-bug-classification-audit.sh exits 0 (all tests including T5 --check-tags tests pass GREEN).
data.title: [GREEN] Add --check-tags mode to bug-classification-audit.sh
